_comment: A FOUR-CONTROL EXTRACT, not a control catalog. The three shipped entries are copied from governance/control-catalog.template.json so scripts/adapter-check.mjs can resolve this example's declarations to real control ids; their `mechanism_ref` / `test_ref` paths resolve from an adopted repository root, not from this directory, so do not run scripts/control-catalog-check.mjs here — it would correctly report ghosts. FLOOR-SEAM is the fourth, and it is the adopting institution's own: the harness does not ship it and must not.

controls.objective: PA1/PA2: a product cannot enter Develop or reach launch without the compiled sections and resolvable control-function approvals
Four-eyes on every merge: no direct pushes to main, CODEOWNERS review required
Immutable control plane: guardrails cannot be changed without Code Owner review; placeholder owners rejected

controls._comment: THE INSTITUTION'S OWN CONTROL. core/floor-adapters.mjs names FLOOR-SEAM in its STREAMS table and says plainly that it does not exist in the shipped catalog: the seam's own liveness is a control an adopting institution must add and own. This example plays that institution. Do not add this entry to governance/control-catalog.template.json — a harness-invented control owned by nobody is the mapping-to-nothing adapter-check refuses.
controls.objective: The collaboration surface is live and was observed refusing a bypass of the seam itself — the stream that vouches for the other streams' plumbing
